title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.7 (Peaked November 21, 2026 at 19:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 342 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)

Pretty calm right now. 🌎💫

A few small sunspots and active regions are visible today, along with a broad dark coronal-hole-like area; the coronagraph shows no clear major outward eruption.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
